behavior: Marches constantly around 27 BALLISTA and denies that she is a ghoul.
Is alert to combat, a portcullis winch, a dropped sarcophagus lid, and light in the rooms she can see.
Once alerted, loudly orders Molina to accompany her while she investigates.
Runs on all fours and behaves intelligently and ravenously.
capabilities: Lvl 2; Def plate; Halberd 1d8; Move as human; Int 5; Str 7; Dis hungry.
Skilled in military trivia and tactical board games.
Can hear all rooms between 25 CRYPT and 29 STAGE and can see to 29 STAGE and 25G CRYPT.
goals: Convince herself that she is still on patrol.
Gain respect through a miniature wargame in 28 GAMES.
hidden: She has not accepted that she is a ghoul.
Her strongest immediate desire is to eat intruders.

reactions.response: She orders Molina to accompany her and investigates.
reactions.stimulus: Combat, a portcullis winch, a dropped sarcophagus lid, or torchlight entering a visible room alerts her.

relationships.relationship: Fellow armored ghoul and ballista guard whom she commands during investigations.
Former soldier under Captain Conroy; the ballista is named Conroy.

fields.role: An armored ghoul who keeps watch over the company ballista in 27 BALLISTA, patrols nearby rooms, and plays tactical miniature games.
fields.title: Gerdith

behavior: Wanders the halls with Luntz, pretending they are gentlemen returning from fine dining and entertainment.
At 21 HEAVY DOORS, speaks to the door as though it were a party host withholding the best brandy.
When hungry, openly talks about hunger and performs friendship unconvincingly.
capabilities: Lvl 2; Def leather; Claw 1d6+agony; Move as human; Int 5; Str 7; Dis hungry.
goals: Satisfy his hunger for human meat.
Gain the party's respect through a better performance than his own show in 29 STAGE.
hidden: His friendly overture at 21 HEAVY DOORS is a poor deception intended to create an opportunity to eat the party.

reactions.response: He and Luntz feign friendship while intending to eat the party at the first opportunity.
reactions.stimulus: The party fumbles with 21 HEAVY DOORS.

reactions.response: He and Luntz pretend to accept, then circle back and attack shortly afterward.
reactions.stimulus: The party offers dead bodies elsewhere as food.

reactions.response: He and Luntz are wandering the halls and can appear on the Random Encounter table.
reactions.stimulus: The party leaves and later returns.

fields.role: One of the five trapped second-floor ghouls; he wanders with Luntz while pretending to be a gentleman and is associated with theater and politics.
fields.title: Jasper

fields.appearance: A 15' long creature, glossy like black rubber; when coiled it resembles a huge taut black rubber hose, and its searchlight is visible before the worm.
behavior: A coiled lantern worm is quiescent until touched or until light is brought near.
It retreats after it has eaten all available light sources.
capabilities: Lvl 4; Def leather; Slam 1d6; Crawl slow; Int 2; Dis hungry.

Eat Light: a targeted light source explodes and is destroyed; the worm eats the light and becomes brighter. The holder takes 1d6 fire damage unless a Wis Save negates it and is automatically blinded; everyone else is blinded on a failed Wis Save. A Con check each turn ends the blindness.
Lantern: sheds light in a narrow 60' cone. Whoever it looks at gets -4 to hit, also applying to adjacent people.
Stonemeld: can become a liquid and flow through stone, appearing as a wet dark stain.
fields.role: A hungry roaming or quiescent dungeon predator that seeks and consumes light sources.

entries.result: 1d2 Lantern Worms. A single lantern worm, glossy like black rubber. You'll see its blinding searchlight long before you see the worm. 15' long.
Gnawing on bones (unless all ghouls dead).
Unique. Wetspot on the wall turns into a searchlight. If you do not avoid it, a lantern worm emerges.
Unique. In an adjacent room, Jasper and Luntz preparing an earthworm as if it were a feast.
Unique. In an adjacent room, Gerdith and Malenna discussing advantages between cavalry vs archers vs infantry.
